implementation: Use the existing event comparison and resource authentication with a distinct candidate/CLI. Every arm decodes using its own unchanged measured SSE policy. Extend existing observer handling for absent SSE rows, plus separate hashes excluding only calibrated probabilities and SSE counts, and explicit event/copy arguments.
scope: Synthetic runner and relocatable bundle checks only. No corpus input read. The parent fixture is reproduced locally, then ten finite fresh CLI phases exercise P/K/D independent inverses, repeats, P/K identity and D observed/unobserved equality.
acceptance: Matching-arm inverse and complete common witnesses
P/K exact payload and all witnesses
P/K/D calibration-free prediction/update and explicit parse identity
Relocated bundle parity and reproducible package bytes
Injected parse divergence rejected with first-divergence evidence
stop_rule: An evidence or inverse failure must be fixed before source sealing or corpus launch. Passing authorizes preparation and publication of the existing lifecycle gate, not an unguarded corpus run. Package, source, raw250KB identity and runtime bounds must be frozen separately before execution.
